sentences.en: I wouldn't dare to question your prowess in video games.
sentences.zh: 我不敢质疑你在电子游戏方面的高超技艺。

sentences.en: His martial arts prowess has already reached a level of sublime perfection.
sentences.zh: 他的武术造诣已经达到了出神入化的境界。

sentences.en: "Could Troy be saved by mortal prowess, mine, / yea, mine had saved her."
sentences.zh: "特洛伊能否凭借凡人的勇力得救，/ 就看我的了，确实是我能救她。"
